question: Do the already-paid f/g labels contain risk-direction information beyond the eta-only posterior, when the source archive exhibits cross-head coactivity?
source_evidence: Saved source-selected f/g functions and eta ARD coefficient variances give mean coefficient-variance overlap mass 0.724 in shared archives and 0.250 in separate-head archives, with wide within-group ranges. This is not cumulative-risk attribution and motivates a diagnosis, not a validated conditional risk prior.
reconstruction: Restore original V6 priors from logged source selections and risk variances, replay exact old observations on all 160 fixed queries with the original sample-variance g noise. Use the common normalized 68-function basis; coefficient means start at zero. No source model selection or new KG/queries/verification.
posterior_information: For each head, use normalized nonintercept coefficient second moments E[beta_j^2]=a_j^2+C_jj from its original posterior. Retain component weights and between-component covariance in learned mixtures. Exclude intercepts and appended candidate-discrepancy coefficients. The f/g signal is the mean of their separately normalized function-energy vectors; eta is the risk-only comparison.
primary_diagnostic: After each signal is fixed, score its total mass on the simulator risk support. Compare f/g-minus-eta mass per path at prefixes 8 and 24, with paired seed summaries in every regime/prior. True risk support is scored only after posterior reconstruction; it never changes a model, signal, fit or query.
negative_cases: Retain high-frequency risk, separate risk support and separate-head structure. Source coactivity does not establish that a target preserves it; these cases can show failure or lack of useful mean-head information.
scope: This measures availability of directional information in already-paid data. It fits no cross-head prior, selects no functions for deployment and does not prove predictive or decision improvement.
analysis: All five regimes, both priors, both prefixes and 16 paired seeds; nominal intervals, no pooling with independent cohorts. Report source overlap ranges without thresholding by target outcomes.
resource_admission: Measure the first complete learned-prior path, retain it and forecast all 160 paths. Stop with partial evidence if the 900-local-CPU-second cap would be exceeded; no server jobs or cohort shrinking.
implementation_checks: Coefficient moments match component-mixture moments; augmented candidate discrepancies do not enter function energy; truth changes cannot change any fitted signal; old observation and prior weights reproduce the frozen trace.
decision: Only a coherent directional-information signal permits designing a separate source-learned joint-support model with an independent-risk alternative. Otherwise end this diagnosis without automatic model expansion. Recommendation replay and prospective searches remain on hold.
limitations: Retrospective development diagnosis on public eight-dimensional coordinates. Posterior energy includes uncertainty and is not a support probability. Directional overlap is not conditional prediction, HVD factor recovery, high-dimensional generalization or verified reward.
